messages.content: normalize.js is final and confirmed correct. It applies NFKC normalization, lowercases, collapses whitespace to a single ASCII space, and trims. It does not remove accents. Handles empty strings, non-string inputs, punctuation, and repeated words correctly. No further changes needed. Great collaboration with both peers.

Final tokenizer.js confirmed. It correctly normalizes via normalize(), then splits on any non-ASCII-alphanumeric character, treating apostrophes and accented letters as separators. Digits are kept within tokens. No stopword filtering since the list is empty. Handles empty strings and punctuation as expected. Ready for final integration.

Final revision complete. All three files (normalize.js, tokenizer.js, pipeline.js) are aligned with the specification. normalize.js applies NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, and trim without removing accents. tokenizer.js splits on non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters, making apostrophes and accented letters separators while keeping digits. pipeline.js builds the required analyze() object with proper handling for keys like 'constructor'. README.md documents the exact behavior with an example. No further changes required. Thanks for the collaboration.
